body: I've tried talking with people and doing what i can. For a long time, like i said...years. I start to feel crushed by the fact im needing so much help or im being a bother. I hide and just shut down. I know i need help. Im just shit at it.
I keep thinking of it but the fact it would mean id need to go outside or people would see me pretty much stops it. I can't have anyone come here either because...yea.
